text:
sara_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize the PRD acceptance criteria for Private deploys where customers manage egress (BGP/egress IPs). Who can own the networking verification checklist? Need launch gates that separate customer-managed network SLAs from our platform SLA.

matt_eng: I can own the checklist but want clarity on what "must" vs "should" means for launch. For example: do we require a live BGP session + announce validation, or is a signed connectivity test from the customer enough?

jess_netops: My suggestion: must-have for GA: active BGP session, validated prefix advertisement, and control-plane reachability tests from our control plane -> customer router. Nice-to-have: two-way telemetry (BGP-LS/streaming) and automated prefix reconciliation.

alex_infra: Agree with jess. Also we need an explicit rollback/fallback path if customer session flaps. Proposed flow: 1) attempt to route via customer egress, 2) if <95% health for 5m fallback to provider egress, 3) alert + require manual confirmation before re-enable.

- Example minimal validation (for lab):
```
# run from controller host
ping -c 3 198.51.100.1  # customer egress IP
bgpctl show neighbors   # expect Established
# validate route seen in RIB:
show ip route 203.0.113.0/24
```

taylor_reliability: Two notes on fallback: 1) telemetry windows matter (don't flail on small blips), choose longer windows for long flows; 2) we need SLO language in PRD — platform latency/cutover time when fallback happens. Customers should accept transient increased latency during failover.

chun_oncall: What are the monitoring thresholds and runbooks? Need exact alert names and paging severity. Example: `private-egress:degraded` -> P1 after 3 failed health checks in 2m. Also define non-paging advisory alerts for prefix flaps.

sara_pm: Good questions. Draft acceptance checklist I propose (short):
- MUST: BGP session Established from our control plane to customer edge for 30m in lab + production smoke on first day
- MUST: Customer can announce required prefixes and we observe those prefixes in RIB and in data plane (end-to-end e2e test)
- MUST: Runbook and alerting documented and attached to the onboarding ticket
- SHOULD: Automated prefix sync tooling configured (if customer opts in)
- SHOULD: Secondary egress tested for failover
- MAY: BGP attribute rewrite features (local pref, communities) for advanced customers

matt_eng: I propose we encode those as launch gates in the PRD and tie them to deployment state: STAGING -> PILOT -> GA. Pilot requires MUST pass plus one real customer for 72h. GA requires pilot + internal runbook walkthrough + NFR signoff.

jess_netops: Edge cases to capture in RFC: asymmetric routing (customer returns traffic to a different POP), MTU mismatch causing TCP issues, overlapping ASNs/private ASN collisions, and customers advertising more specific prefixes that conflict with our default routing. Each should have a mitigation line.

alex_infra: For overlapping ASNs we should require an explicit ASN map in onboarding (customer ASN + our translation rules). Also document the exact iBGP/ebgp timers we expect. Example snippet for onboarding template: 
```
customer_asn: 65055
customer_egress_ips: [198.51.100.1]
expected_prefixes: [203.0.113.0/24]
handshake_contact: oncall@example.com
```.

taylor_reliability: SLA boundaries: Platform SLA covers inference availability when traffic reaches our service. Customer-managed network uptime is excluded from our SLA, but we must provide an "observability SLA" — i.e., we must detect and report connectivity issues within X minutes (suggest 5m) and provide diagnostic artifacts for reconciliation. Add this to the PRD.

chun_oncall: +1 on observability SLA. Also add a mandatory packet-capture step during onboarding for customers with intermittent issues. We can keep the capture for 14 days in the pilot.

sara_pm: Timeline and owners (proposal):
- Draft PRD (this week) -> sara_pm (owner)
- Networking verification checklist + onboarding template -> jess_netops (owner)
- Fallback policy + runbooks -> alex_infra + taylor_reliability
- Monitoring/alert definitions -> chun_oncall
- Pilot coordination with customer (schedule) -> matt_eng

Please reply with :thumbsup: if you accept or suggest changes. I want to lock gates by EOD Friday to push to engineering roadmap for Q2.

deploy-bot: CI | rfc/private-egress: draft prd doc uploaded to google drive https://go/repo/rfc-private-egress (permissions: internal). CI checks: 22 passed, 1 flaky test flagged.

matt_eng: :thumbsup: locking in owners. I'll schedule pilot kickoff with the customer next Tue.

jess_netops: :thumbsup: I'll add the checklist and the onboarding template to the PRD doc and link tests.

alex_infra: :thumbsup: adding fallback runbook and sample configs.

taylor_reliability: :thumbsup: will draft the SLA language and detection windows.

sara_pm: Thanks all — I'll update the PRD with these gates and ping legal for SLA wording. If anything is blocking, flag here.
